issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

initialScheduleDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before a worker will start processing invalidation queue requests.

idleSleep.description: Sleep time in milliseconds between invalidation queue sweeps when the last sweep found nothing to process.

retryCount.description: Maximum number of attempts to retry compute for queue entries when retryable errors occur.

recoveryIntervalMinute.description: Time between sweeps for recovering stuck queue entries.

depthLimit.description: Maximum recursive depth limit for asynchronous processing.

emptyQueueCheckSeconds.description:
The number of seconds that a queue that has entries will continue to be checked during the lock operation once it
no longer has entries.

maxConcurrentProcessingThreads.description: Maximum number of parallel processing threads for cloud queues.

store.description: Backing store (e.g. handles queue entry persistence, locking, etc.) for the invalidation queues.

schedQueueTimesResetIntervalMinute.description: Interval for resetting the accumulated time consumed by tags for scheduling "fairness"

queuesToMonitor.description:
Queues to monitor. When included, {@link #statsToMonitor} will be included for the queue.
Do not include "Queue" at the end of each entry, example: use ["Cron", "CalcFields"] instead of
["CronQueue", "CalcFieldsQueue"].

statsToMonitor.description:
{@link InvalidationQueueStats} (names of the fields) to monitor for the queues specified in {@link queuesToMonitor}.
{@link InvalidationQueueStats#pendingActions} will never be available.
example: use ["initial", "awaitingCompute", "failed"]

default.description: Default queue config for any queues not specified above.
